A. Infrastructure Implementation and Deployment Support end-to-end implementation and deployment of airport eGate infrastructure across multiple cities and airport locations. Install, configure, and commission physical servers, workstations, network equipment, and associated eGate infrastructure. Coordinate hardware installation, operating system deployment, network configuration, application prerequisites, and infrastructure integration. Perform infrastructure validation, connectivity checks, system testing, and operational readiness assessments before handover. B. Windows Server and Group Policy Administration Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server and Windows Client operating systems in accordance with approved infrastructure standards. Perform server and workstation configuration, domain joining, user administration, service management, and routine system maintenance. Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory and Group Policy Objects (GPOs). Understand how Group Policy is used to centrally enforce security settings, password policies, access restrictions, workstation configurations, and other domain policies. C. Network, DNS, Firewall and VPN Administration Demonstrate working knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, gateways, and network connectivity troubleshooting. Understand IPv4 address classes and private, public, loopback, and link-local addressing, including Automatic Private IP Addressing (APIPA). Configure and troubleshoot DNS resolution, DNS records, DNS caching, static and dynamic DNS configurations, and name-resolution failures. Understand DNS filtering/blocking mechanisms and support approved DNS-based access-control and security policies. Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot site-to-site VPNs and remote-access/client VPN connectivity. D. VMware Virtualization and Server Infrastructure Demonstrate practical knowledge of VMware virtualization technologies, including VMware ESXi and vSphere environments. Understand the differences between Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors and the operational use cases for each. E. Hardware Installation and Troubleshooting Perform hands-on installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of physical servers, PCs, workstations, and infrastructure components. Understand server hardware components, including motherboards, CPUs, RAM, storage devices, RAID controllers, power supplies, and network interface cards. Support server rack installation, equipment mounting, cable management, power connectivity, and hardware commissioning as required. F. Candidate Selection Criteria Candidates should be assessed for practical capability in the following areas: Windows Server administration and Group Policy. DNS, IP addressing, switching, routing, VPN, and FortiGate firewall fundamentals. VMware ESXi installation and basic virtualization administration. Physical server and network infrastructure installation.

review_candidates.description: Network Engineer Cisco / Arista / SD-WAN / Multi-Site European WAN Sunbury-on-Thames (Hybrid - 3 days on-site p/w) £50,000 - £60,000 + Benefits Are you a network specialist who wants genuine ownership rather than a ticket queue? This is a hands-on role with a live project attached: a migration of the edge switching estate from Cisco to Arista across multiple buildings, with a firewall replacement following close behind. A globally recognised company based in Sunbury-on-Thames is looking for a Network Engineer to join its MIS function. You'll own the day-to-day availability, performance and security of the network across the UK and Europe, working to an architecture and security standard set by the global US head office and within a well-established ISO 27001 framework. Your Key Responsibilities Project Delivery: Play a central role in migrating the edge switching estate from Cisco to Arista, and in the firewall replacement programme that follows. Multi-Site Network Operations: Administer and support LAN, WAN and site-to-site connectivity across the UK, Paris and Munich, ensuring consistent availability and performance. Enterprise Infrastructure: Configure, manage and maintain switches, routers, firewalls, SD-WAN and wireless across all European locations. Security & Compliance: Maintain network security controls in line with ISO 27001, managing firewalls, VPNs, VLANs and access control policies. Proactive Monitoring & Resolution: Monitor performance, availability and capacity, resolving issues before they reach users. Lifecycle & Resilience: Own firmware upgrades, patching and device lifecycle management, and support disaster recovery and business continuity including global DR site connectivity. Improvement: Identify and deliver improvements to the existing network rather than simply maintaining it. Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate network documentation and diagrams, and work alongside internal MIS colleagues and third-party vendors. Your Skills & Experience Core Networking: Solid hands-on Cisco experience across routing and switching, LAN/WAN, VPNs, VLANs, firewalls and wireless in a business-critical environment. Arista: Any commercial exposure to Arista is a significant advantage given the migration ahead. You don't need to be a specialist, and Arista certification is a bonus rather than a requirement. Multi-Site Exposure: Experience supporting connectivity across more than one site, ideally internationally, with SD-WAN experience a strong advantage. Security Mindset: Working knowledge of network security principles and best practice, ideally within a formally accredited environment. Desirable Extras: Aruba, VMware vSphere, Zscaler or cloud networking experience. Approach: This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to do the work rather than direct it. Strong troubleshooting, clear communication and the judgement to prioritise independently. Experience counts for more here than certifications. Practicalities Occasional travel to European sites, typically around once a year for hardware work, plus visits to the global head office in the US. Participation in an on-call rota, which in practice is called on infrequently. You'll need to live within a sensible commute of Sunbury-on-Thames.
